A report's rows of the ARD definition

Source: R/ard_spec.R
ard_rows.Rd

ard_rows() gives the rows of an ARD definition sheet the app shows for a report (analyses: that report's; the other sheets are the study's); set_ard_rows() puts them back, edited.

Usage

ard_rows(x, sheet, output_id = "")

set_ard_rows(x, sheet, output_id = "", rows)

Arguments

x

A tflplanner.

sheet

analyses, datasets, populations or study.

output_id

A report, or "" / NA for every row.

rows

The rows, edited.

Value

ard_rows(): a data frame; set_ard_rows(): the tflplanner.
